* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Effect: You Cannot Hide Forever & •Mobilization Points, Coruscant, R
|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/youcannothideforeverandmob.html</ref>

This card combines extra Force activation with a good searching ability. Early in the game you can use the [[Mobilization Points]] portion of the card to activate additional Force at docking bays, and later on, once your Force generation is secure you probably don't need the additional activation at docking bays, so you can lose the card to get that key [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] or DSII card such as Search and Destroy or Overseeing it Personally.

If your opponent is playing Never Tell Me the Odds, this protects you

for playing this card. A clever insert player can stock [[Don't Do That Again (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty){{!}}Don't Do That Again]] and by suspending [[Mobilization Points]], is effectively suspending your Odds protection also.
